method: Single-author manuscript/source readback and claim-boundary review; no independent agent or new scientific run.

claims.boundary: Three fixed mechanisms, two fresh contexts and three arms; not eighteen independent tasks or a population estimate.

claims.boundary: The reset-placement-r1 and package-response-r1 fixed-rule runs retain original INCOMPLETE_OR_STOPPED despite direct submissions before request-cap stops.

claims.claim: Actual typed consumption counts are 1/4/3 and are path statistics.
claims.boundary: Direct submission is allowed for every arm; path-specific conjunction is not a comparative success metric or proof of autonomous discovery.

claims.claim: Requests are 37/59/50 and acquired logical source bytes are 89,218 for every arm.
claims.boundary: Refinement has no observed accuracy or acquisition-volume advantage; more requests and a slightly lower estimated fee form a mixed cost result.

claims.source: Settled usage aggregated by the canonical B report
claims.boundary: Formula uses total input/output at USD 0.30/1.20 per million; reasoning is not added again; estimates are not invoices, preparation cost UNKNOWN.

claims.claim: Input information access and execution permission are equal; initial payloads differ.
claims.source: shared/final-input-audit.json and actual API payload audit
claims.boundary: Complete-information initially contains full sources; fixed-rule/refinement are catalogue-first. No byte-identical-prompt claim.

claims.claim: Storage, reset-placement and package-response outcomes are explained by already saved trajectories.
claims.source: Five exact-input raw.json.zlib files identified in data/source-manifest.json
claims.boundary: Prescribed-source digital model only. Proxy agreement at a frozen input is not an exact criterion over its declared domain or physical calibration.

claims.claim: First legal consumer rehearsal establishes a real input-to-execution edge.
claims.boundary: Researcher supplied, zero model requests, excluded from eighteen formal attempts; prediction UNKNOWN and coverage false remain.

claims.claim: Later arms use a warmer shared cache; host evaluation has no separate saved timer.
claims.source: B evaluated-input, cache and timing receipts
claims.boundary: No algorithmic cache-savings or host-only-duration inference. Total wall, tool wall, initial payload and token volumes are separate axes.

claims.claim: Earlier E5 result remains seven PASS and five INCOMPLETE; original rejection and post-hoc rehearsal remain separate.
claims.source: Preserved final manuscript and its immutable tables/failure logs
claims.boundary: No retrospective relabeling or rescue of original outcomes.

claims.claim: New C has 24/24 event-component passes but no success/request/fee gain versus equal-history control.
claims.boundary: Ideal continuously powered time component; four earlier 32768-token stops remain in the original denominator. False frozen conditions on a passing design do not alone prove unsoundness.

claims.claim: New A finite package has all four final service cases FAIL despite integrity PASS.
claims.boundary: Initial plus two revisions, twelve four-case executions, finite single/parallel catalogue only. Dark-new-sampling local PASS is retained; no global infeasibility. Product NOT_ACCEPTED, physical NOT_CALIBRATED.

claims.claim: Selected single-module cold-start requirement is 0.19881 J versus at most 0.162 J in 1800 seconds.
claims.source: Frozen selected minimum capacitance 72 mF and minimum ready voltage 2.35 V; prescribed source 90 microwatts
claims.boundary: Starts uncharged, exact finite module and deadline; does not exclude unselected series architecture or prove all A/R architectures impossible.

limitations: No new hardware measurements or official benchmark result.
No venue-compliance or broad literature-priority review.
Underlying model weights UNKNOWN behind reported alias deepseek-flash.
Compilation is local; old full raw-data package remains external and is not copied into this folder.
